native.native_domain: Exact original application execution with direct external-call interception; no Core instructions. Descriptor rebind after first call, terminated lists and eligibility bytes; 136 connection messages. D1 app dispatch writes and provider call only.

provider_domain: Direct actual CCL Component destruction baseline (target 0), separately compared with each partial app class. Masks 0..7 select first heap child, two array-owned children and last heap child. Event ids record virtual child destruction order; after -1 is actual Child::operator delete count (arrays use actual CCL TComponentArray delete[]). No original Core execution or binary/layout equivalence claim.
